description: Image Description: The image depicts a serene natural scene featuring three elephants in a lush, green environment. In the foreground, an adult elephant stands prominently on the left side, facing slightly to the right. Its large ears are spread out, and its trunk is curled downward, touching the ground. The elephant's skin is wrinkled and gray, typical of African elephants, and it has visible tusks. To the right of the adult elephant, a smaller, younger elephant stands close by, likely a calf
